d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, ekdam majedaar wala badam milk ki recipe share kar raha hu, ye truck me jo milte hai na, usse bhi jyada tasty rahega, bottle wala badam milk se bhi jyada maja aaega, isme maine ek secret ingredient bhi dala hai jo ki sahi me secret hai - lal khova, jo bhun bhun kar banta hai aur ye flavor ke lie jarur se dala jata hai badam milk mein.. aap bhi try kariega!
Badam - 1/4 cup + 10-12 pc
Milk - 1.5 litre
Custard powder - 1 1/2 tbsp
Lal khova - 3 tbsp
Chini - 120 gm
Ilachi powder - 1/8 tsp
